slides.title: INNER = [[sirf match]]
points: Dono tables mein **match** mila? Row aayegi
slides.note: Dating app: **dono ne right swipe** kiya tabhi match 💘

slides.title: Orders ka [[match]]
slides.note: Customers: Aarav(1), Meera(2), Kabir(3), Riya(4). **Kabir, Riya** ka koi order nahi

slides.title: INNER JOIN [[likho]]
slides.code:
SELECT c.name, o.amount
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN orders o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id;
slides.note: **c** aur **o** = aliases. Chhota likho, kaam bada 😎

slides.title: Kaun [[gayab]] hua?
slides.note: Ek customer ke jitne orders, utni **rows**. Ye normal hai!

slides.title: JOIN vs [[INNER JOIN]]
slides.note: Team code mein **INNER JOIN** likho, padhne wale ko clarity milti hai

slides.wrong: INNER JOIN se **saare customers** aane ki ummeed
slides.right: INNER JOIN = sirf **match wale**. Sab chahiye? **LEFT JOIN**
slides.why: Kabir, Riya ka order nahi → INNER JOIN mein **dikhenge hi nahi**
